propositions: Compacted authorship-ledger entries retain pre-rewrite commit SHAs; when commit history is rewritten, the stored SHAs become stale and the verifier misclassifies authentic events as key-not-valid-at-era.

The verifier trusts non-null stored commit SHAs and only falls back to position resolution when the stored SHA is null, causing it to miss events whose positions have been remapped by history rewrite.

The fix must treat ledger commit_sha as a cache and prefer resolution by position against current history over the recorded SHA, while retaining the recorded SHA as fallback when position resolution fails.
Live-event behavior, ledger wire format, persisted schema, event bytes, and null-commit recovery behavior must remain unchanged.
